name: Skew Slide Button
description: A React button hover effect: the label swaps letter by letter, the resting copy leaning back and sliding out while a second copy slides in upright behind it, chevrons included; the plate swells on hover and squashes on press. Pure CSS transitions with Tailwind, no JS.

props.name: children
props.description: The label (plain text; it is split into letters).

props.name: href / onClick
props.description: With href it renders a link, otherwise a button.

props.name: arrow
props.description: Show the double chevron after the label; it swaps with the letters.

props.name: className
props.description: Font and size go here (made for a condensed display face, uppercase).
